say:3:1611135001:0.text: The Memory Star I wanted... You really did find it.
say:3:1611135001:0.source_cn: 我想要的记忆之星——你们果然找到它了。
say:3:1611135001:0.male: The Memory Star I wanted... You really did find it.
say:3:1611135001:0.female: The Memory Star I wanted... You really did find it.

say:4:1611135002:0.text: Hand it over, or I'll take it by force. Need a moment to decide?
say:4:1611135002:0.source_cn: 交给我，或者我抢走它。你们要商量一下再给我个答案吗？
say:4:1611135002:0.male: Hand it over, or I'll take it by force. Need a moment to decide?
say:4:1611135002:0.female: Hand it over, or I'll take it by force. Need a moment to decide?

say:5:1611135003:0.text: Gervan? Your legs... they really are healed.
say:5:1611135003:0.source_cn: 格墨文？你的腿……果然已经痊愈了。

say:6:1611135004:0.text: You've suspected me for some time, haven't you? All those tests, those probing questions... Well, here's your answer, clear as day. Aren't you satisfied now?
say:6:1611135004:0.source_cn: 你不是早就怀疑我、试探我了吗？我现在给了你一个明确的回...

say:7:1611135005:0.text: ... Why would you sink so low? Don't you care about yourself—or your family's honor?
say:7:1611135005:0.source_cn: ……你为何要自甘堕落！你不在乎自己，也不在意家族的声望吗？

say:8:1611135006:0.text: Oh, I care plenty about myself. That's why, when the Adamant Syndicate offered me a way to heal my legs, I agreed without a second thought.
say:8:1611135006:0.source_cn: 我很在乎自己啊，所以当我得知有机会治好腿伤时，立刻答应...

say:9:1611135007:0.text: As for my family... what have they ever given me?
say:9:1611135007:0.source_cn: 至于家族……家族给了我什么？！

say:10:1611135008:0.text: A Marquis, heir to the Hastings line, a man of rank and power in the court—how could he be someone who can't even walk without a wheelchair?
say:10:1611135008:0.source_cn: 堂堂的世袭侯爵、黑斯廷斯家族的继承人、宫廷里的实权者，...

say:11:1611135009:0.text: "Doesn't Marquis Gervais have any other heirs? How disgraceful!" If I had been whole, those whispers would never have reached my ears.
say:11:1611135009:0.source_cn: “嘉德侯爵难道没有其他继承人了吗？这也太不体面了”！如...

say:12:1611135010:0.text: My family was watching me, testing me. They wanted to see if I could live up to the Hastings name. They weighed my worth, judged me, and looked for a place to set me down—like a cracked piece of porcelain.
say:12:1611135010:0.source_cn: 家族在观察我的反应。看我能否担得起黑斯廷斯之名，他们权...

say:13:1611135011:0.text: But I'm not porcelain. I healed myself!
say:13:1611135011:0.source_cn: 但我不是瓷器，我治愈了自己！

say:14:1611135012:0.text: If you had just talked to someone, your friends—
say:14:1611135012:0.source_cn: 如果你能找其他人商量商量，找你的朋友——

say:15:1611135013:0.text: Friends? What good would that do? Could they make me the next Marquis?
say:15:1611135013:0.source_cn: 朋友？商量又能怎么样，能让我成为下一任侯爵吗？

say:16:1611135014:0.text: But the Adamant Syndicate was different. They promised to restore my legs, to give me everything a Marquis should possess—
say:16:1611135014:0.source_cn: 但黑金商会不一样，他们承诺让我的双腿恢复如初，得到嘉德...

say:17:1611135015:0.text: —all I have to do is take the Memory Star from your hands.
say:17:1611135015:0.source_cn: ——只要我拿到你们手中的这颗记忆之星！
say:17:1611135015:0.male: —all I have to do is take the Memory Star from your hands.
say:17:1611135015:0.female: —all I have to do is take the Memory Star from your hands.

say:20:1611135016:0.text: D-don't even think about it! Gervan, this is the real Magister Merlin. You can't possibly win!
say:20:1611135016:0.source_cn: 你、你别想！格墨文，你面前这位是真正的梅林大人！你绝对...
say:20:1611135016:0.male: D-don't even think about it! Gervan, this is the real Magister Merlin. You can't possibly win!
say:20:1611135016:0.female: D-don't even think about it! Gervan, this is the real Magister Merlin. You can't possibly win!

say:21:1611135017:0.text: The Adamant Syndicate is just using you as a pawn! Once they get what they want, they'll throw you away!
say:21:1611135017:0.source_cn: 黑金商会只是在利用你，将你当做破局的棋子。只要达成目的...

say:22:1611135018:0.text: ... It's too late for that, Silven. You know me. Once I choose a path, I don't turn back. And I can't now.
say:22:1611135018:0.source_cn: ……已经走到这一步，休，你知道的，我不会回头，也无法回头。

say:23:1611135019:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I know you're Merlin. The one I once looked up to, the one I could never catch up to. My greatest rival.
say:23:1611135019:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I know you're Merlin. The one I once looked up to, the one I could never catch up to. My greatest rival.
say:23:1611135019:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I know you're Merlin. The one I once looked up to, the one I could never catch up to. My greatest rival.
